verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents several APIs, including an HTTP API, Pixel API, Event Audit API, and Transformations management, but nothing in the evidence offers a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. A probe of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404 everywhere. Human-readable API reference pages are adjacent and do not count as a machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
